## Ans.  
All the allowances, except pay, are exempt from attachment by order of the Court. Hence, the amount that can be recovered from the salary of the officer in satisfaction of the decree will be-  
- 1-8-2023 to 30-6-2024 (Salary for August, 2023 to June, 2024)  
| Emolument | | 60,400 | | | | |
